parsed.notes:
The qualifications sections are required; 'A plus for this role' makes its items optional.
Alternatives and examples are labeled individually without implying that every alternative must be possessed.
Shipping GenAI solutions into production is read literally as AI deployment; continuous evaluation is explicitly part of the requested understanding.
LLM frameworks has no exact broad taxonomy entry; it is not silently equated with orchestration. Its named examples are labeled separately.
Unmapped Azure AI Foundry and LLM frameworks are optional; the other unmapped practices are required.
Skills appearing only in responsibilities, including embeddings, vector search and API integration, are excluded.
The English-language posting asks for neither German nor a degree.
